This is the selected same character with a new approved thick ponytail, not a redesign.

turnarounds.prompt:
Create a precise GAME CHARACTER PRODUCTION TURNAROUND SHEET for ONE adult woman, based on the attached references. REFERENCE 1 is the immutable facial identity master. REFERENCE 2 is this character's selected full-body clothing/hair/body source. Preserve her specific face and realistic painted material quality. Never reuse another character's face or a generic beauty template.
Exactly THREE equal roomy columns in this order: FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC, RIGHT SIDE ORTHOGRAPHIC (woman faces viewer left so her right side is visible), BACK ORTHOGRAPHIC. Same single character in all three views. FULL BODIES from hair crown to both boot soles, same global scale and common baseline; generous margins and empty gaps between figures. Long horizontal landscape canvas, three full height figures, do not overlap limbs, cloth or ponytail across columns. No text, numbers, labels, grids or arrows inside the image.
Modeling stance: comfortable symmetric A-POSE, feet planted apart, knees straight but relaxed, arms 25 degrees away from torso, elbows almost straight, fingers relaxed gently spread and visible. No weapon in either hand. Neutral upright head, level face and eyes in front view, neck straight, no tilted fashion/model pose, no hip cock or contrapposto. Side and back preserve the same arm and leg pose through the rotation. No foreshortening or perspective enlargement, no beauty camera lens, no 3/4 views.
Use clean flat diffuse studio lighting, neutral middle-gray background, no dramatic rim light, no cast ground shadow hiding feet, no floating pieces. Large clear anatomical and costume forms. Back-view outfit must be a mechanically plausible continuous construction of the front design, not random new accessories. Do not put facial features on the back of the head. Every rigid metal part remains solid with fixed edges. This is SOURCE ART for future geometry/rigging; preserve anatomical structure, separate upper arms from torso, leave thigh gap and distinct fingers for clean silhouettes. Character: the selected Woni-reference BARE-ABS heroine. Keep her exact eyes, nose length, lip proportions and small cheek mole in front, the SAME natural adult face as reference 1. Keep thick HIGH BLACK-BROWN PONYTAIL, clearly connected to crown with one substantial tail down behind shoulders to upper waist; right side and rear show its mass and attachment. A little forehead fringe allowed, no half-up long loose lower hairstyle. Compact athletic female proportions around seven heads, not stretched model legs. High-neck NAVY cropped protective leather top covers chest, bare naturally toned ABS AND WAIST, full dark fitted trousers cover BOTH thighs, short navy asymmetric shoulder mantle, flat practical boots. Character LEFT forearm carries ONE BLUE CORE in a distinctive sculptural dark-metal gauntlet; must stay on anatomical LEFT arm in all views (front viewer right, rear viewer left). Right forearm simple wraps/glove. No second blue core, no bare thigh. Mantle is short and must not hide rear leg silhouette or ponytail connection. Keep the costume and silhouette from reference 2, do not redesign it into a different armor set.
